source_citations.citation: Vandenheever, D., Davidson, H., Kemp, J., Murphy, Z., Kujawa, A., Shi, J., Nadorff, M. R., Bates-Brantley, K., & Sidwell, M. (2025). Preliminary evidence for anxiety-linked neural sensitivity to emotional faces using fast periodic visual stimulation. International Journal of Psychophysiology, 214, 113212.
source_citations.source_locator: Methods ROI paragraph that lists O, PO, F, CP, left LOT, and right ROT electrode sets; the article uses an article number rather than stable page ranges.
source_citations.evidence_scope: Primary source for the six electrode sets and the separate expression-specific ROI-by-anxiety-group analysis precedent.

source_citations.citation: Vandenheever, D., Davidson, H., Kemp, J., Murphy, Z., Kujawa, A., Shi, J., Nadorff, M. R., Bates-Brantley, K., & Sidwell, M. (2025). Exploring facial expression processing with fast periodic visual stimulation and diverse stimuli. Brain and Cognition, 189, 106338.
source_citations.source_locator: Methods and ROI-level facial-expression analysis in the companion FPVS report; the article uses article number 106338.
source_citations.evidence_scope: Companion-method context for the facial-expression FPVS ROI framework; the anxiety paper above is the direct source for this configured analysis.

notes: LOT, ROT, O, Frontal, and PO reproduce the Vandenheever et al. (2025) definitions used in the audited ACR follow-up.
FCz is used because the anxiety paper prints FCs, while the BioSemi64 workbooks contain FCz and no FCs; confirm this likely typographical correction before manuscript reporting.
CP is aggregated only for the configured anterior/posterior amplitude-ratio analyses and is not part of the five-ROI LMM family.
